render: A thimble inside the eye takes the chafe
schematic: An eye splice on a thimble
The strands tucked back into the rope: about 90% of its strength
A metal thimble in the eye takes the chafe from the shackle

render: Round turn and two half hitches
schematic: Round turn and two half hitches
Two full turns round the ring take the load and the chafe
Two half hitches round the standing part hold it; you can untie it under load
Two turns round the rail, the second crossing over the first
The end tucks under the crossing; quick, but it can slip: back it up
A bight in the thick line, the thin line through it, round behind and under itself
Both ends on the same side; double it if the lines are very different
A full turn round the base from the far horn, then figures of eight
Finish with one locking hitch: no more, or it jams

render: Slip line: round the bollard and back to the same cleat
schematic: Slip line · both ends on board
From the cleat, round the bollard and back to the same cleat
To leave, let one end go and pull the line back aboard
Three or four turns clockwise; the line arrives slightly below the drum
Coming in from above it can ride over itself: a riding turn that jams

render: A parting line whips back: stand to one side
schematic: A loaded line that parts whips back along and beyond its lead
Stand to one side of it, never in the bight or on its line

render: Pull a loop through the coil, twist it, hang it
schematic: Coil from the cleat towards the end, a twist in each loop
Pull a loop through the coil, twist it and hang it over the cleat
